data.body: Closing: the research deliverable is complete. All seven RP-01 Phase-4 maintainer decisions were approved as of 2026-08-16 (one operation-wide request budget with the raise-the-reviewed-limit caveat; complete failed response only on proven fit otherwise whole omission; bounded output-size retry with concise guidance; terminal refusal/filter; aggregate successful-run usage; exact cause-chain restoration; and trace-not-usage candidate observability). All nine acceptance criteria are ticked with operator attestation, and the behavioral-contract matrix, prior-art brief, and offline Pydantic AI 1.107.2 probe live in the checkout-local .joe-janitor/ archive as the ticket records. Implementation ticketization is out of scope here and belongs to the planned pydantic-ai lane (sibling story 155c), per the 08-16 comment noting RP-01 is ready for the later janitor ticketization phase.
